newsitem.title: USA: Kollmorgen sells 48 percent stake in Gretag.
newsitem.headline: Kollmorgen sells 48 percent stake in Gretag.

text.p: Kollmorgen Corp., a producer of electronic motion control systems, said Tuesday it sold its 48 percent stake in Gretag-Macbeth Holding AG for more than $40 million.
The sale was made through a public offering of Gretag-Macbeth shares on the Swiss stock exchange.
Kollmorgen said it agreed to sell its shares to the Swiss underwriter, Bank J. Vontobel & Co. AG. The Waltham, Mass.-based company expects to receive most of the proceeds before June 30.
Gretag-Macbeth Holding AG was formed in January as a joint venture between Kollmorgen's Macbeth business and the Colour Control Systems division of Gretag AG.
Gretag-Macbeth will be listed on the Swiss stock exchange on June 25.
"We will be in a position to reduce outstanding debt as well as invest in our core business of high-performance electronic motion control," said Gideon Argov, Kollmorgen's chief executive.
Kollmorgen's stock fell 12.5 cents to $14.625 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
